s: October 11, 2023 - The Vendace fish (Coregonus albula) is one of three whitefish species native to the British Isles. The preferred habitat of the Vendace fish is deep cold lakes, where it feeds on planktonic crustaceans, such as copepods. The Vendace fish is one of the UK’s rarest freshwater fish.
